text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the spring Tenno Sho on the horizon and her schedule as packed as ever, Symboli Rudolf attends to another round of interviews.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the process, she announces the academy's first "Mega" Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following Air Groove's collapse, Symboli Rudolf has been working like a person possessed to reassure those around her that she can still be relied upon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her answer to her own perceived shortcomings is to work harder, run faster, and show the world that the Emperor is flawless.
